attributes.name: Sorrowsoul
attributes.powers:
On a check against a bane by a character at your location, after the roll, recharge this card to add 1 for each die that is a 1 or 2. If the check invokes the Cold or Undead trait, add an additional 1.

Discard this card to explore your location; on all checks during this exploration, after the roll, add 1 for each die that is a 1 or 2.
